nodes.description: The CSC (CFAP61, CFAP91 and CFAP251 with calmodulin) sits at the base of radial spoke 3 and links it to the doublet microtubules. Loss of any one subunit destabilizes the others: CFAP251 is lost from sperm of men with CFAP61 variants and from Cfap91 knockout sperm, and in Cfap251 knockout mice the radial spoke proteins RSPH1 and RSPH3 are reduced along the flagellum. Radial spoke 3 therefore fails to assemble.

nodes.description: Co-immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry of mouse testis identified the beta-tubulin TUBB4B and the mitochondrial ADP/ATP carrier SLC25A4 as CFAP251 partners, and both co-immunoprecipitate with CFAP251 in vitro. In elongating spermatids both colocalize with tubulin, and in mature sperm TUBB4B is enriched in the principal piece and SLC25A4 in the midpiece. Both proteins are reduced in Cfap251 knockout testis and along knockout sperm flagella, and their flagellar signal is reduced in sperm of men with CFAP251 splice variants. The authors propose that CFAP251 is a scaffold for the stable incorporation of TUBB4B and SLC25A4 into the flagellum; this rests on one study.
